ps_files: opencode has no scoped rules
ps_agent: opencode has no scoped rules
ps_skill: skill "../escape": the name is not a single folder name
ps_cred: skill file scripts/token.json matches the credential exclusion list
ps_cmd: the command has no prompt
ps_cmdname: the name has no characters usable in a file name
ps_cmdmeta: written without argument-hint, which opencode command files do not take
ps_subname: the name has no characters usable in a file name
ps_allow: opencode has no rule that allows one MCP server without also matching others
ps_native: opencode native permission entries are not supported
ps_foreign: nothing in this permission applies to opencode
ps_hook: opencode has only JS plugins
ps_nomcp: the item has no server definition
ps_sse: transport "sse" is not supported by opencode
ps_both: an http server needs a url and no command, args or env
ps_bare: a stdio server needs a command and no url or headers
